dependencies.reason: The managed OS disk is an intrinsic part of the virtual machine's storageProfile and is created with the VM. It is a managed disk, NOT a Storage Account.
dependencies.securityImpact: Managed disks are encrypted at rest with platform-managed keys by default.
dependencies.costImpact: OS disk incurs managed-disk storage cost for the lab duration.

dependencies.reason: A network interface is required to connect the virtual machine to a subnet.
dependencies.securityImpact: The NIC binds the VM to a subnet governed by a network security group.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the NIC itself.

dependencies.reason: A virtual network provides the private address space for the VM's subnet.
dependencies.securityImpact: Defines the private network boundary. No inbound internet access by default.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the virtual network itself.

dependencies.reason: A network security group is attached so inbound access is denied unless an inbound rule is explicitly added by the author.
dependencies.securityImpact: Default posture denies inbound internet traffic. Rules are opt-in and reviewed.
dependencies.costImpact: No direct charge for the network security group.

dependencies.reason: A public IP address is only added when the author explicitly requests inbound internet access to the VM.
dependencies.securityImpact: Exposes the VM to the public internet. Requires justification and restrictive inbound rules.
dependencies.costImpact: Standard public IPv4 addresses incur an hourly charge.

dependencies.reason: A Storage Account for boot diagnostics is only added when boot diagnostics are explicitly enabled. This is a Storage Account, NOT a managed disk.
dependencies.securityImpact: Stores boot diagnostic logs; should not be publicly accessible.
dependencies.costImpact: Incurs Storage Account transaction and capacity charges.

evidence.rationale: Authoritative property set for the virtual machine resource.

limitations: SKU/size availability varies by region and subscription quota; this tool cannot confirm live availability.
Windows vs Linux osProfile differs; the correct image reference must be supplied by the author.
